approval: Founder, 2026-09-14: put the new EPL model live and proceed.
supplements: data/internal/research/epl/reports/epl-history-replay-preregistration.json (2b8921861) and its one-look receipt (e8346033e: eloPoisson ELIGIBLE). This file registers the live adoption and its blind forward test before any adopted forecast exists. It changes no constant of the model.

rules.model: app/src/lib/sports/epl/elo-poisson.mjs reproduces the replay's arithmetic with the registration's frozen block; its warm-up supremacy slope is recomputed on every build and must match the receipt (0.5851) or the previous model publishes. A parity test re-scores dev season 2023-24 through the module.
rules.data: data/internal/research/soccer/epl/history-openfootball-v1.json (openfootball, public domain), refreshed by the EPL matchweek workflow before each forecast build. Fixture names resolve to history names through the EPL alias table in leagues.mjs.
rules.whatPublishes: Team forecasts (1X2, totals, both teams to score, scorelines, margins, clean sheets) and the score matrix the player projections allocate from — every rung of runEplShadow unchanged.
rules.control: While adopted, the previous split-Poisson model is fit on its own corpus at the same cutoff and its probabilities ride the private forecast row. The grader scores both on every graded match.
rules.forwardTest: Paired per-match log loss, new minus previous, over graded forecasts generated on or after adoptedAt. ACCUMULATING below minimumN; then FORWARD_BREACHED when the whole 95% event-bootstrap interval (resamples, seed below) is above zero, otherwise FORWARD_HOLDING (flagged watch when worse on the point estimate).
rules.reversal: A FORWARD_BREACHED receipt makes the next build publish the previous model (match-model.mjs). The receipt is rebuilt before the forecasts in every matchweek run.
rules.population: Exactly what the grader grades: pre-kickoff forecasts of record on the priced rung (CURRENT_PRE_EVENT), official full-time results.
